# PTTStella macOS software raster patch

This is the published `i-slint-renderer-skia` 1.18.1 crate, including its upstream licenses. `PTTSTELLA-UPSTREAM.json` records the crate SHA-256, upstream Git identity and every original package file hash. Only `lib.rs` and `software_surface.rs` are changed; `software_shadow.rs` is added. The root Cargo patch selects this source for both Slint feature configurations. The retained-raster change is macOS software only. The snapshot correctness fix applies to any surface using partial rendering.

The pinned softbuffer 0.4.8 CoreGraphics backend allocates a zeroed buffer for every presentation, reports age 0, and ignores damage rectangles. Slint consequently repaints the entire window, even when only an inline animation changed. This patch retains one private BGRA raster per software window. A successful render can reuse that raster with age 1; allocation, geometry/stride change and render errors invalidate history and require a full repaint. Shrinking the window replaces the allocation so fullscreen storage is released.

The completed private raster is copied into softbuffer's independent target before presenting. No memory owned by a CGImage or CGDataProvider is mutated; there is no native pointer or synchronization change. This still copies and presents the complete frame and adds one window-sized BGRA allocation; it does not implement zero-copy, reduce the scale factor, skip animation frames, or claim OS presentation timing.

`SkiaRenderer::take_snapshot` shares item trackers and dirty history with the window, but renders into a separate buffer. After producing a snapshot it now marks the complete window dirty and requests a redraw, so a retained window does not treat snapshot-only content as already painted. A regression first fails against the published renderer when footer geometry changes and a snapshot is taken before the window repaint. The snapshot remains a toolkit raster, not OS presentation evidence.

The root `slint_rendering` integration test compares independent full and retained windows, includes snapshot-before-window-paint, and requires genuine partial animation updates afterwards. Tests also exercise partial-frame preservation, independent handed-off bytes, equal-byte aspect changes, stride changes, failed-render invalidation and shrink allocation release. Root commands must use the existing `.local/slint-build.toml` target. Example: `cargo --config .local/slint-build.toml test --locked --release --features native-player-probe -p pttstella -p i-slint-renderer-skia --lib`.

Revisit this patch when upstream's software presentation buffer preserves valid contents and reports its age, or exposes a compatible public surface integration. Remove the root Cargo patch and restore the registry source/checksum for this package in Cargo.lock when retiring the local copy; do not edit the shared Cargo registry.

Upstream references: [Slint Skia software surface](https://github.com/slint-ui/slint/blob/v1.18.1/internal/renderers/skia/software_surface.rs), [softbuffer 0.4.8 CoreGraphics](https://github.com/rust-windowing/softbuffer/blob/v0.4.8/src/backends/cg.rs), [upstream presentation investigation](https://github.com/rust-windowing/softbuffer/issues/83).
